meta.title: VFL Betting Playbook — Definitive Edition
meta.verdict: The VFL odds market is HIGHLY EFFICIENT. No systematic pre-match edge exists. The ONLY edges are situational — in-play signals after HT/first-goal, specific matchup tier exploitation, and Cassandra's two validated stress edges. Never bet draws. Never use the sovereign model.

market_reality.efficiency: Actual vs implied probabilities align within 0.1% — the bookmaker knows what they're doing
market_reality.kelly_verdict: Walk-forward Kelly loses money at EVERY confidence threshold. Even at the 'best' threshold (63%), the win rate of 66.7% still yields -36.25% ROI because odds adjust down.
market_reality.key_insight: A simple 'pick the favorite' strategy (52.2% accuracy) beats the sovereign model (41.4%) by over 10 percentage points. The sovereign model is actively harmful.

T1.profile: Dominant. M.Blue best home (63.4%), Liverpool best away (49.5%). Strong favorites in most matchups.

T2.profile: Strong at home, vulnerable away. LDN Guns have big home/away gap (57.5% vs 35.3%).

T3.profile: Mid-table. Everton strongest at home (43.6%). Brighton weakest in tier.

T4.profile: Relegation fodder. Bournemouth worst away (13.3%). Fulham worst home (24.5%).

team_tiers.tier_overlap: NONE — tiers are cleanly separated with no overlap in win ranges

pre_match_signals.signal: T1 home vs T4 — bet HOME
pre_match_signals.rationale: T1 teams win ~63-67% at home. T4 away win rates are 13-23%. The math is overwhelming. Market prices this in but the win probability exceeds the implied odds slightly in the mid-range (2.0-3.0). Best when T1 odds are 1.50-1.80 — actual win rates are 62-68% vs implied 60-67%, giving a small +1-2% edge.
pre_match_signals.sample_size: ~199 seasons × 4 T1 × 5 T4 matchups per season ≈ massive

pre_match_signals.signal: T1 away vs T4 — bet AWAY (odds > 1.80)
pre_match_signals.rationale: T1 away win rates are 44-50%, and T4 home win rates are only 25-32%. At odds > 1.80, the breakeven is 55.6% but actual win rate for T1 is ~60%+ against T4 at home. The edge emerges because T1 away odds often inflate beyond fair value.
pre_match_signals.sample_size: ~199 seasons × 4 T1 × 5 T4 matchups per season ≈ massive

pre_match_signals.signal: T2 home vs T3/T4 — bet HOME
pre_match_signals.rationale: T2 home win rates (50-58%) vs T3/T4 away win rates (13-29%). The gap is large enough that the market doesn't fully price it in. Best in 1.60-2.00 odds range.

Cassandra's stress test: heavy_dog_draw shows +4.50% edge in first half of data and +4.03% in second half. This is the ONLY validated draw edge. Applies when big underdog faces strong favorite — draws happen more often than the market expects (28.6% actual vs 24.1% implied). SMALL STAKES ONLY.
pre_match_signals.caveat: This is the ONE exception to 'never bet draws'. Still risky — use 1% stake max.

pre_match_signals.signal: Slight home underdog — bet HOME (Cassandra-validated edge)
pre_match_signals.rationale: Cassandra validated: slight_dog_home shows +1.30% in first half and +2.09% in second half. Small but real edge — slight home underdogs outperform market expectation slightly.

Page's odds efficiency analysis: home odds 2.0-2.5 show actual 43.4% vs implied 41.4% (+2% edge). Home odds 2.5-3.0 show actual 46.7% vs implied 35.8% (+10.9% edge). Promising but Gideon's stability check shows this varies — some odds buckets are positive, others negative. Use as a FILTER, not a standalone signal.
pre_match_signals.caveat: Combine with tier analysis. A T3 home at 2.50 vs T2 away is different from T4 home at 2.50 vs T1 away.

pre_match_signals.rationale: Torin's streak analysis: 3 home wins streak → next: 42.9% home win (only slightly above baseline 44.2%). Streaks don't create meaningful edges. The market already adjusts.

pre_match_signals.signal: Home team coming off big loss
pre_match_signals.rationale: Big loss → next: 44.1% home win. Almost exactly at baseline. No edge — this is narrative, not signal.

in_play_signals.signal: Home team leads by 1 goal at HT → BET HOME
in_play_signals.rationale: Home 1-goal HT lead → 75.7% FT home win (Torin) / 82.2% regardless of margin (Page). The 2-goal gap jump is even bigger. In-play odds will have adjusted but often not enough — the market overestimates comeback probability. This is the STRONGEST signal in the entire dataset.
in_play_signals.confidence_jump: 1-goal lead → 75.7%. 2-goal lead → 94.4%. The +18.7pp certainty jump at the 2-goal threshold is massive. If you're already on HOME and they go 2 goals up at HT, CONSIDER ADDING.

in_play_signals.signal: Away team leads by 1 goal at HT → BET AWAY
in_play_signals.rationale: Away 1-goal HT lead → 68.3% FT away win (Torin) / 75.0% (Page). Away 2-goal HT lead → 91.0%. Slightly less predictive than home leads but still very strong. The certainty jump from 1 to 2 goals is even bigger for away teams (+22.7pp).

in_play_signals.signal: Home team scores first → BET HOME (if odds still favorable)
in_play_signals.rationale: Home first goal → 75.9% FT home win. First scorer wins 71.7% of all matches. If you can get odds above 1.25 after home scores first, it's value. Market adjusts fast though.

in_play_signals.signal: Away team scores first → BET AWAY (if odds > 1.35)
in_play_signals.rationale: Away first goal → 66.5% FT away win. Less reliable than home-first but still strong. Away-first-then-lose happens in 13.3% of cases (vs 7.9% for home-first-then-lose).

in_play_signals.signal: 0-0 at HT → BET DRAW (only if both teams are similar tier)
in_play_signals.rationale: 0-0 at HT: Draw most likely outcome (38.4%), more than home (34.7%) or away (26.9%). 1-1 at HT shows similar pattern. But this is STILL under 40% — you'll lose more than you win. Only bet if the draw odds are generous (> 3.50).

in_play_signals.signal: Team leading by 2+ goals at any point → HEDGE OR ADD
in_play_signals.rationale: Home 2-goal HT lead → 94.4% FT home win. Away 2-goal HT lead → 91.0%. At 3 goals it's 99%+. These are virtual locks. If your bet is losing, HEDGE. If you're on the right side, ADD. The market underrates how rarely 2-goal leads collapse.

red_flags: NEVER bet draws pre-match. The sovereign model proved this conclusively: draw predictions are 19.9% accurate vs natural draw rate of ~25%. Even Cassandra's validated heavy_dog_draw edge should be treated as a rare tactical exception, not a strategy.
NEVER use the sovereign model's LOCK or SIGNAL tiers. They have -99.9% ROI. A coin flip outperforms them.
NEVER flat-bet all favorites. Proven -6.8% ROI. The vigorish grinds you down.
NEVER bet against a T1 team at home. T1 home win rates are 57-63%. Unless the in-play signal is overwhelming (opponent leads by 2+ at HT), don't fade T1 at home.
NEVER bet T4 teams away. Bournemouth away win rate is 13.3%. Fulham away is 18.1%. These are donation bets.
AVOID betting when HT score is 0-0 and the teams are mismatched tiers. The draw rate drops significantly in tier-mismatch 0-0 games — the better team eventually scores.
AVOID betting on 'momentum' narratives — streaks (3 wins, big loss bounceback) show zero predictive edge. The market doesn't leave narrative gaps.
AVOID betting late-season 'must-win' games as underdogs. Upset rates are only ~23% across all phases; the favorite still wins 52-54% in late season. Desperation doesn't create value.
AVOID the moderate dog draw (Cassandra INVERTED edge — negative in both halves). This is ANTI-VALUE. If you see a moderate underdog and think 'draw', you're falling into a market trap.
NEVER chase losses. The Kelly analysis shows that even with a 66.7% win rate at 63%+ confidence, ROI is -36%. The market is too efficient for recovery betting.

T1_home_vs_T4.strategy: BET T1 HOME (any odds up to 1.35)
T1_home_vs_T4.confidence: Highest confidence pre-match bet available. T1 home win rates are 57-63% overall, but specifically against T4 (away win rates 13-23%) this jumps to ~65-70%. The market offers ~1.20-1.30 which implies 77-83% — but our data says it's more like 65-70%. WAIT — this means there's NEGATIVE edge at those odds. Bet ONLY if you can get 1.50+. Otherwise use as in-play trigger: if T4 scores first, T1 odds will lengthen and you can get better entry.

T1_away_vs_T4.confidence: T1 away win rates (44-50%) spike against T4's weak home records (25-32%). At odds > 1.80 (breakeven 55.6%), actual win probability of ~58-62% provides genuine edge. Best T1 away bet.

T1_home_vs_T1.strategy: WATCH — no pre-match edge. Use in-play signals
T1_home_vs_T1.confidence: T1 vs T1 is close to a coin flip at home. Liverpool away beats Man Blue home sometimes. The market prices this efficiently. Only bet after first goal or HT lead.

T1_home_vs_T2.confidence: T1 at home vs T2 has a real edge — T2 away win rates are only 35-41%. T1 should win ~58-62% at home vs T2. At odds 1.55+ (breakeven 64.5%), it's marginal. Better as an in-play trigger.

T2_home_vs_T3.confidence: T2 home (50-58%) vs T3 away (26-29%). Solid gap. Odds typically 1.70-2.00. Good value.

T2_home_vs_T4.confidence: Strong edge. T2 home win rates (50-58%) vs T4 away (13-23%). This is a tier-and-a-half gap. T2 should win ~60% of these.

T3_home_vs_T3.confidence: T3 home win rates are only 36-44%. Draws happen ~25% of the time. No clear edge. Wait for first goal or HT lead.

T3_home_vs_T4.confidence: T3 home (36-44%) vs T4 away (13-23%). The gap exists but T3 home win rates aren't high enough to justify short odds. Only bet if odds > 1.65.

T4_home_vs_T4.strategy: AVOID. Total coin flip with high variance
T4_home_vs_T4.confidence: T4 home win rates are 25-32%. Even T4 vs T4 at home doesn't create clear favorites. Skip entirely.

T4_home_vs_T1.strategy: BET T1 AWAY if odds > 1.50. Or watch for T4-first-goal then bet T1
T4_home_vs_T1.confidence: The trap matchup. T4 home (25-32%) vs T1 away (44-50%). T1 should win ~50-55% of these. If T4 scores first (unlikely but possible), T1 odds will drift and you can get great entry. The T4-first-goal-then-fade is a valid in-play strategy.

stake_sizing.strategy: Fractional Kelly — 1-3% of bankroll per bet

rules.description: In-play HT lead signals, T1 home vs T4 with good odds
Tier mismatch pre-match, first-goal signals, Cassandra validated edges
Mid-range odds filter, slight edges, WATCH signals that look good

stake_sizing.bankroll_management: Start with defined bankroll. Never add funds mid-session. If down 30%, halve stakes until recovery. If down 50%, stop and reassess.

strategy_matrix.pre_match_primary: Tier-based favorite betting with Cassandra edge overlay
strategy_matrix.pre_match_tertiary: Heavy underdog draw (Cassandra validated — use sparingly)
strategy_matrix.in_play_primary: HT lead signals — the strongest edge in the dataset
strategy_matrix.in_play_secondary: First goal signals — bet the scoring team
strategy_matrix.in_play_tertiary: 2+ goal lead — add to winning position or hedge losing one
strategy_matrix.never_do: Bet draws (except Cassandra edge), use sovereign model, chase losses, bet T4 away, flat-bet favorites

one_sentence_model: Pick the favorite, adjust for tier mismatch (T1 beats T4, T2 beats T3), layer in-play HT-lead and first-goal signals for the real edge — never bet draws and never trust the sovereign model.

sovereign_model_autopsy.verdict: The sovereign model is a significant net destroyer of capital. Stop using it.
sovereign_model_autopsy.vs_simple_favorite: A 'pick the favorite' model (52.2%) beats the sovereign model by 10.8pp
sovereign_model_autopsy.draw_underperformance: The model predicts draws WORSE than random chance. The GLOBAL DRAW SURGE strategy is the worst-performing variant.
sovereign_model_autopsy.WEAK_tier: 51.6% accuracy but 0% ROI because stakes were zero — these weren't real bets
sovereign_model_autopsy.recommendation: Decommission the sovereign model for betting purposes. If the infrastructure has value for data tracking, keep it — but do not use its predictions to place bets.

quick_reference_card.best_pre_match_bet: T1 at home vs T4 — but ONLY if odds > 1.45
quick_reference_card.best_in_play_bet: Home team leading by 1+ goal at HT → bet HOME FT
quick_reference_card.only_draw_worth_betting: Heavy underdog draw (Cassandra +4.27% edge in both halves)
quick_reference_card.biggest_trap: Betting draws in any other context — the sovereign model proved they're 19.9% accurate
quick_reference_card.biggest_surprise: The market is SO efficient that 66.7% win-rate bets at 63%+ confidence STILL lose -36% ROI because the odds adjust perfectly
quick_reference_card.golden_rule: Pre-match picks the favorite + tier adjustment. In-play is where the money is made.
